usedFor: Hostfully holds your rental bookings and Asana holds the work, so “New Booking” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Hostfully, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each booking becomes a task with assignee and dates, so turnover work has an owner.

watchOut: “Updated Booking” is a separate trigger, so a changed stay will not edit the task “Create Task or Subtask” made.
